name: Naturepedia x402 Retrieval Pricing Map
author: Robbie George
system: Naturepedia / Robbie’s Razor / Grand Compression / RKCA

coreAvailabilityRule.description: A configured pricing class or syntactically valid route does not establish that a payable resource exists.

pricingTiers.name: Free Discovery and Previews
pricingTiers.useCase: Metadata, endpoint descriptions, previews, health information, licensing signals, public control-plane resources, and machine discovery.

pricingTiers.name: Atomic Canonical Query
pricingTiers.availabilityPolicy: Payment challenges are issued only for explicitly registered Atomic Query resources with complete governed deterministic payloads.

failureBehavior.registeredCompleteResource: 402 Payment Required with amount 5000 and gateway tier atomic

pricingTiers.useCase: One narrowly bounded canonical fact, identifier resolution, routing result, or compact canonical answer.

pricingTiers.name: Enriched Relationship Query
pricingTiers.availabilityPolicy: Published pricing does not activate an Enriched resource. Payment challenges remain disabled until a governed deterministic payload is explicitly registered, availability-gated, fidelity-bound, and production validated.
pricingTiers.useCase: Multiple relationships, citations, provenance, or modest enrichment.

pricingTiers.name: Structured Plate
pricingTiers.availabilityPolicy: Payment challenges are issued only for registered, validated, complete Structured Plate payloads.

failureBehavior.registeredCompletePlate: 402 Payment Required with amount 250000 and gateway tier single-plate

pricingTiers.useCase: One complete structured Plate payload with governed relationships, citations, provenance, and applicable governance fields.

pricingTiers.name: Bounded Subtree, Registry, or System Map
pricingTiers.availabilityPolicy: The $5 pricing class does not activate every taxonomy subtree, Registry, identity graph, or System Map. Each protected resource must be explicitly registered, complete, and payment-eligible.
pricingTiers.useCase: One qualifying bounded multi-record taxonomy subtree, Registry, identity graph, or System Map retrieval.

pricingTiers.name: Full Registry or Knowledge Mesh Snapshot
pricingTiers.availabilityPolicy: The $25 pricing class does not activate every full Registry, Knowledge Mesh, RRIP-related resource, state-related resource, or premium snapshot. Each protected resource must be separately registered and production-ready.
pricingTiers.useCase: One qualifying explicitly registered large machine-readable package, such as a full Registry snapshot or Knowledge Mesh snapshot.

publicControlPlaneBoundary.interpretation: These exact endpoints are public discovery or control-plane resources. Their existence does not imply that similarly named protected $5 or $25 resources exist.

rules: route template does not imply resource existence
pricing class does not imply resource registration
registry discovery does not imply protected payload availability
architectural resource type does not imply production instantiation
public control-plane endpoint does not imply paid counterpart

hopfBoundary.interpretation: Hopf Fibration is an established mathematical reference and public discovery resource. No paid Hopf Registry, Plate map, Knowledge Mesh, or x402 product should be inferred unless explicitly created and registered later.

rightsBoundary.x402Conveys: One endpoint-level retrieval of the identified protected resource under the applicable access terms.
rightsBoundary.commercialDataRights: Requires a separate written agreement where offered.
rightsBoundary.frameworkImplementationRights: Requires a separate enterprise agreement where offered.

rules: payment challenge does not equal settlement
settlement does not equal empirical validation
resource registration does not equal factual validation
schema validity does not equal scientific correctness
canonical status does not equal independent empirical confirmation

productionValidation.scope: Challenge and availability behavior recorded for the resources listed below. This record does not imply settlement testing for every current pricing class.

interpretation: This repository file is a non-enforcing reference mirror. The live production pricing manifest, explicit production resource registration, availability state, and actual production responses remain authoritative.

attribution.role: Author and Originator of the Grand Compression framework and Architect of Record for Naturepedia
attribution.externalTechnologyBoundary: x402, Base, USDC, HTTP, JSON, Cloudflare, and other external protocols and technologies retain their independent provenance.
